prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was in Chongqing for a quick work stopover, and I remember I’d been browsing hotel options there the night before.
That same spring I also spent a couple days in Chengdu, and I’d jotted down a bunch of attractions to wander around between meetings.
For the Chongqing night, the stay ended up being at Holiday Inn Jiangbei, checking in on 2025-03-15.
It was just 1 night, and the booking was under Gao Yan—pretty sure my coworker handled it and I just showed up.
Later on, a friend told me they’d already gotten a ticket for Kuanzhai Alley for 2025-04-18 in the morning—1 ticket, under Noah Wilson.
